title: Dev 360 | Chasing Global Rankings On a Crumbling Planet | Patralekha Chatterjee
description: Yet, one in 10 people globally still lives in extreme poverty. Food insecurity remains well above 2015 levels, affecting 2.3 billion people. More than 150 million children are stunted. Maternal mortality remains nearly three times the global target. Everyday discrimination — still felt by one in five people worldwide — continues to limit human potential
